title: Curious Urgency 33
author: bpatrick
body: New Curious Urgency! How is it that if you have something to do that’s only two hours but it’s in the middle of the day it destroys your whole day? Maybe it’s just me. I’m in the mire – I can’t get anything done and always feel on-edge and frantic but like I’m doing nothing. Like the nightmares where you’re running as fast as you can and getting nowhere. I’m in the nightmare.
